notes.design: Hold it up and walk in: while it is in hand, hits from attackers within 60 degrees of where you face lose 60 % (blasts with no attacker and hits from the side or behind get through); a bash for 30 that shoves (8 m/s). You move a little slower (0.92). Switch to a gun to shoot back.
notes.model: The Meshy community space shield (CC0; weapons intake of 2026-11-18), 0.74 m wide, its handle toward you; the knife is the fallback.
